## Summary of changes

Two focused refactorings in `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math3/util/FastMath.java`:

**1. Extracted `sqrtExtendedPrecision(double za)` helper** — `asin` and `acos` shared a 7-line block that computed `sqrt(za)`, took its 30-bit Veltkamp split into `(ya, yb)`, and applied the standard precision correction `yb += (za - ya² - 2·ya·yb - yb²) / (2y)`. The helper returns `{y, ya, yb}` so both callers consume the same result and only diverge afterward (`asin` keeps `y` for division, `acos` folds `zb` into `yb` and re-splits).

**2. Unified the three reduction steps in `CodyWaite`** — the constructor previously had one "initialize" step plus two "accumulate" steps that performed the same compensated TwoSum. By initializing `remA = xa; remB = 0.0` up front, the first step takes the same shape as the other two, so all three subtract `k * (one of the PI/2 precision parts)` via the same TwoSum operation. The three magic constants moved into a `PI_OVER_TWO_PARTS` table and the body becomes a 3-iteration loop. Bit-for-bit identical because IEEE-754 addition is commutative.

All 71 `FastMathTest` tests and 66 `FastMathStrictComparisonTest` tests still pass unchanged. No public APIs, signatures, numerical behavior, or dependencies were modified.
